replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design shows receipt posted and premium unlocked with no transaction binding or reuse check; replay attack concrete."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"Evidence shows server trusts client-supplied receipt/flag without store verification; forged receipt attack distinct from replay."},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Endpoint quoted with no stated auth or account binding; granting premium on others' accounts is a distinct attack."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Entitlement granted on client flag with no transaction record; non-repudiation/revocation harm distinct from prior threats."}]}
